parsed.summary: PLAN-B74 is thoroughly designed, methodologically rigorous, and addresses all prior review comments from rounds 1 and 2. Look-ahead bias is strictly prevented (clear pivot confirmation delays, out-of-sample parameter calibration, symmetric wave rule verification, and automated 50-day point-in-time cross-checks). Statistical testing is sound (block bootstrap for overlapping returns, Bonferroni-Holm family-wise error rate control, and multi-regime robustness splits). LLM hallucination and cost controls are well-bounded with daily token caps, price-hallucination detection thresholds, and graceful fallbacks.

findings.issue: Intraday partial bar is injected into memory during 09:00–13:35. If wave_snapshot caches this state without a dedicated short TTL during market hours, clients might receive a stale intraday snapshot for up to 10 minutes.
findings.suggestion: Explicitly distinguish cache TTL between market hours (e.g. 1–2 minutes or no-cache for intraday partial bars) and off-market hours (static snapshot until scheduled update).

findings.issue: Gemini Google Search Grounding response structures occasionally vary between SDK versions or when no search results are returned, which could cause JSON parsing exceptions in the news digest step.
findings.suggestion: Ensure the Google Search Grounding extraction wrapper has fallback parsing to handle empty or malformed grounding chunks without throwing unhandled exceptions.

parsed.coverage: Evaluated data pipelines (TWSE, Yahoo, FinMind, MIS), ZigZag pivot confirmation logic, Elliott wave hard rules and scoring, support/resistance zone clustering, chip and foreign index factors, multi-horizon block-bootstrap research validation, AI panel orchestration with token quotas, and UI/UX performance optimizations.
parsed.limitations: Review is based on PLAN-B74.md design document and architectural specifications; actual execution performance and Yahoo/FinMind rate-limit resilience will require verification during staging run and automated test suite execution.
